title: 極紫外曝光製程整合
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究系統與圖形、材料與光罩、窗口與缺陷、電性與整合；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: system and patterns, materials and masks, window and defects, electrical integration. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 系統與圖形
stages.description: EUV 以反射式光學與真空路徑成像，材料與光罩都參與成像誤差。
stages.descriptionEn: EUV uses reflective optics and vacuum paths; materials and masks both contribute imaging errors.

steps.title: 畫出光源至晶圓的反射路徑
steps.titleEn: Sketch the reflective source-to-wafer path
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput.
steps.instruction:
畫出光源至晶圓的反射路徑。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：在假設的四面反射鏡教學光路中，每面能量反射率皆為 0.70，且忽略其他損失。總傳輸比例為 0.70⁴=0.2401；100 單位入射能量只剩 24.01 單位。若其中一面因污染變成 0.60，剩餘為 0.70³×0.60=20.58，較原來降低 14.3%。本例鏡數與反射率不是任何 EUV 機台規格。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch the reflective source-to-wafer path. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): In a hypothetical four-mirror path, each mirror has energy reflectivity 0.70 and other losses are ignored. Total transmission is 0.70⁴=0.2401, leaving 24.01 of 100 incident energy units. If one mirror falls to 0.60, the result is 0.70³×0.60=20.58, a 14.3% relative decrease. Mirror count and reflectivities are not specifications of any EUV scanner.
steps.observation:
EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
用乘積得到 24.01 與 20.58，不可把反射率直接相加。
steps.observationEn:
Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Use products to obtain 24.01 and 20.58; do not add reflectivities.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「EUV 可直接套用透射玻璃鏡頭。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "EUV can directly use transmitting glass lenses.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:
交付「畫出光源至晶圓的反射路徑」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「EUV 光路各反射介面都影響能量。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
本例驗收：用乘積得到 24.01 與 20.58，不可把反射率直接相加。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Sketch the reflective source-to-wafer path", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Each reflecting interface affects EUV throughput." and retain one limitation.
Example acceptance: Use products to obtain 24.01 and 20.58; do not add reflectivities.

steps.observation: 公平比較需一致設計目標。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: A fair comparison needs matching design targets. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「EUV 可直接套用透射玻璃鏡頭。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "EUV can directly use transmitting glass lenses.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「選擇可比的 DUV 或 EUV 對照流程」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「公平比較需一致設計目標。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Choose a comparable DUV or EUV reference flow", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "A fair comparison needs matching design targets." and retain one limitation.

knowledge.title: 本步技術判讀
knowledge.text: 公平比較需一致設計目標。
knowledge.textEn: A fair comparison needs matching design targets.

knowledge.title: 系統與圖形的原理與限制
knowledge.titleEn: System and patterns: principle and limits
knowledge.text: EUV 以反射式光學與真空路徑成像，材料與光罩都參與成像誤差。
knowledge.textEn: EUV uses reflective optics and vacuum paths; materials and masks both contribute imaging errors.

quiz.question: 完成「選擇可比的 DUV 或 EUV 對照流程」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Choose a comparable DUV or EUV reference flow", which interpretation is defensible?
options: EUV 可直接套用透射玻璃鏡頭。
最薄光阻一定最適合所有圖形。
公平比較需一致設計目標。
optionsEn: EUV can directly use transmitting glass lenses.
The thinnest resist is best for every pattern.
A fair comparison needs matching design targets.
quiz.explanation: 公平比較需一致設計目標。 EUV 以反射式光學與真空路徑成像，材料與光罩都參與成像誤差。
quiz.explanationEn: A fair comparison needs matching design targets. EUV uses reflective optics and vacuum paths; materials and masks both contribute imaging errors.
